description: Theoretical European option price and Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega, rho) from Black-Scholes, given manual spot/strike/days-to-expiry/volatility/risk-free-rate inputs plus an optional continuous dividend yield for stocks and ETFs (the implied-volatility and option-chain tools do not take one): no live data fetch. The live variant is workflow.run_black_scholes_live, which applies when checking a real Deribit, Binance or Bybit instrument, since that variant also reports how far the instrument's actual quoted price sits from what this formula implies. Prices are USD-denominated (the universal convention); callPriceCoin/putPriceCoin additionally divide by spot to match Deribit's own coin-settled quoting convention. Assumptions: European exercise only, one flat volatility for the whole life (no smile or skew), constant rate and dividend yield, a year of 365 calendar days, theta per calendar day. Edge cases: spot, strike, daysToExpiry and volatilityPct must be above zero; riskFreeRatePct and dividendYieldPct must be between 0 and 100, so a negative rate is refused; a deep out-of-the-money option returns a price and Greeks of exactly 0, and a very low volatility or very short expiry gives a very large gamma and theta, not an error. Not covered: early exercise (use workflow.run_american_option), discrete dividends, negative rates, transaction costs, taxes, margin, and Greeks adjusted for coin-settled (inverse) options: Greeks are standard USD Black-Scholes Greeks. Use when user asks "what should this option be worth at X% IV?" or wants raw Greeks for a hypothetical. Returns: callPriceUsd/putPriceUsd, callPriceCoin/putPriceCoin, deltaCall/deltaPut, gamma, vegaPerPct (per 1 vol point), thetaCallPerDay/thetaPutPerDay, rhoCallPerPct/rhoPutPerPct (per 1 rate point).

daysToExpiry.description: Calendar days until expiry (can be fractional)

dividendYieldPct.description: Continuous dividend yield in percent per year (1.2 means 1.2%), for stock and ETF options. Default 0: crypto has none. Range 0 to 100.

riskFreeRatePct.description: Risk-free rate in percentage points. Default 0: standard crypto-options convention.

volatilityPct.description: Annualized implied volatility in percentage points, e.g. 60 for 60%

name: workflow.run_black_scholes
title: Black-Scholes Option Price and Greeks
